title: Rusty the Fox and the Starlight Path
description: A little fox finds his way home through the misty woods by following glowing fireflies in the grass.
character_reference: a small bright red-orange fox cub with a bushy white-tipped tail and inquisitive dark eyes

scenes.narration: Rusty stayed out playing in the forest long after the sun dipped below the hills. The misty woods suddenly looked unfamiliar in the gathering dusk, and he felt a little flutter of worry.
scenes.visual: deep forest path surrounded by soft fog and tall ferns under fading twilight light

scenes.narration: He sat down softly on a bed of cool moss, wondering which way led back to his warm den. Suddenly, a tiny spark of light flickered right in front of his nose.
scenes.visual: small red-orange fox cub sitting alertly on soft green moss with ears perked forward

scenes.narration: It was a friendly firefly, glowing with a warm amber light as it hovered above a hidden winding trail. The little bug zipped forward a few inches and waited.
scenes.visual: bright glowing insect floating near green clover leaves in the dim evening shadows

scenes.narration: Rusty trotted quietly behind the floating beacon as more fireflies joined in to illuminate the path. Together, they painted a sparkling trail across the forest floor.
scenes.visual: small fox cub walking cautiously along a dark dirt path illuminated by scattered glowing bugs

scenes.narration: The warm lights led him straight past the old hollow log and right to the entrance of his cozy underground den. He had made it home safely.
scenes.visual: cozy earthen burrow entrance framed by wild ferns and warm glowing fireflies in the twilight

scenes.narration: Rusty turned around and gave a grateful yip to his glowing friends before they fluttered away into the night. He felt brave for following the light.
scenes.visual: small fox smiling warmly toward hovering glowing lights near the mouth of a cozy den

scenes.narration: Curling his bushy tail around his nose, he drifted off to sleep in his warm, safe bed. Every shadow holds a friendly light if you know where to look.
scenes.visual: small fox cub curled up tightly asleep on a bed of dry leaves inside a dark den

scenes.narration: May the stars guide you safely to sleep tonight. Follow along for more gentle bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: peaceful night sky filled with shimmering stars and soft glowing clouds over a quiet forest
